categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Tianli Technology primarily operates in two main segments: mobile information services and insurance product services. The mobile information services include ICT business, MAS (Mobile Agent Server) business, and software customization, focusing on integrated mobile information application platforms and communication services. The insurance product services encompass insurance brokerage, insurance technology, and insurance service operations through subsidiaries, providing professional insurance brokerage and innovative insurance product design.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages technologies such as 5G messaging, cloud computing, IoT, big data, and AI to enhance its mobile information services. It employs Just-In-Time production methods via its Yixintong platform to optimize communication service delivery and reduce costs. In insurance services, it develops proprietary platforms including distribution, business data management, and vehicle insurance installment management systems, emphasizing digital transformation and software development for operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily financial institutions including banks, securities firms, and insurance companies, especially in the financial vertical market. The company also serves clients in internet, e-commerce, logistics, and public services sectors. Geographically, its major markets include Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Jiangxi province, with a nationwide presence through branch offices.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jiangxi Tianli Technology operates mainly within China, with significant revenue generated from Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Jiangxi. It has established branch offices across major provinces to provide timely and precise services, covering most regions nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the mobile information and insurance service supply chains. It integrates communication resources from telecom operators and provides value-added services to enterprise clients, while in insurance, it acts as a broker and technology service provider connecting insurers and customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on digital transformation of its core businesses, enhancing 5G messaging capabilities, and expanding cooperation with technology service enterprises. It prioritizes R&D in smart enterprise platforms, encrypted messaging, insurance management systems, and health management services. The company aims to strengthen technology innovation, compliance, and team capabilities to build a technology-driven insurance service institution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of mobile information services and insurance product services. The mobile segment earns income from ICT platform services, MAS business, and software customization, while the insurance segment derives revenue from brokerage commissions, insurance product sales, and technology service fees. The company also gains investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangxi Tianli Technology is a pioneer in mobile information technology services with mature resources, technology, and stable client relationships, especially in the financial sector. It holds a competitive position due to early market entry, strong operator partnerships, and integrated insurance service platforms. The company faces competition intensified by regulatory changes and market entrants but leverages its brand, technology innovation, and comprehensive service capabilities to maintain its market standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 444.36 million, a slight decrease of 1.28% year-over-year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.36 million, representing a 127.21% increase. Total assets reached RMB 581.87 million, up 7.45% from the previous year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its first-mover advantage, deep industry expertise in financial verticals, and strong operator relationships to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and precise mobile information services. Its integrated insurance service ecosystem combining brokerage, technology, and service platforms offers differentiated value through innovative product design and digital capabilities. The focus on technology innovation, comprehensive service models, and nationwide coverage underpins its competitive differentiation.
